headline: Asian Markets Open Sluggish, South Korea's Kospi Plunges Nearly 4%
summary: Asia-Pacific stock markets opened weaker, led by South Korea's Kospi, which fell 3.91% at the open. The broader regional sell-off was evident from the start of trading.
why: The Kospi is South Korea's main equity benchmark, dominated by large technology and semiconductor companies, so its moves signal shifts in regional risk sentiment.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index fell 3.91% at the open, leading the regional decline.
